<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Consumer Policy:</strong> The Union Power Minister has clarified that the installation of prepaid smart meters is not mandatory for consumers, addressing concerns regarding utility infrastructure.</li>
  <li><strong>Housing Protests:</strong> Homebuyers affected by the Supertech project have announced plans to march to Parliament, citing a lack of progress on their housing units over the past 21 months.</li>
  <li><strong>Regional Alliances:</strong> In Assam, ruling alliance partners have reached a consensus to contest the upcoming Nagaon Lok Sabha by-election as a unified front.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxOb3VqNUpxMHphUXJyQy1UXzJQVjNMQWZZekE1aHB3N3dLR0JfYzVoTGk5cFJzd3JtZ2swVGlHdHpEYW1iRFl5b2IyWC12aWQyRV8wS1ZSOXJ2WXpVS3RFYW5lcmFtUnpnU2o1enFNU1RxLUdHX04zbEpxWFdoMExqSFp6amlwRWJYMVMtRTJRUTZQSjFhVldqbE5rS0podEI4b1ZSRzNkYUpCT2ltWjdhYjF3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
